content.content: Apply these criteria to the dependent's recorded statement, not to code. (1) Consistency: no clause of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite; fail on any contradicting clause, naming it. (2) Licence: every clause must specify something the prerequisite itself states — the page presented in the panel, or that page being interactive for a graph whose size varies — and must not require a rule the prerequisite does not state (a latency or frame budget, a node-count or graph-size ceiling, a rendering technique, a library, file or protocol, a host or process other than the panel). Fail on any clause that needs such a rule, naming the clause and the missing rule. (3) Elaboration, not restatement: the statement must add a cost condition the prerequisite does not already state; a statement that only paraphrases 'interactive HTML page' fails as vacuous. (4) No substitution: the cost condition must tie the work of a user interaction to what that interaction changed and must state, together with it, that the cost does not follow the number of visible nodes. A statement carrying only one half has changed the subject — to a budget, to a capacity claim, or to a mechanism — and fails, naming the missing half. (5) Decidability: from the recorded statement alone, a reviewer must be able to name what would refute it without supplying a rule of their own — at minimum, two interactions that apply the same change to different numbers of visible nodes, whose measured cost differs. If no such observation can be named from the statement, fail. The review checks that the elaboration is licensed and decidable; it never demands that behaviour be observed at review time.
content.rationale: vylxkuxr states a structured (EARS) requirement whose only content is that the graph is presented inside a VS Code webview panel as an interactive HTML page; the dependent is inline prose, a commitment in words. The evaluation matrix has no structured-to-natural cell, so this edge takes the default (gate) form — check non-violation of the prerequisite, never demand behaviour of a prose child — and is flagged for a matrix entry. The use is that the dependent turns one word of the prerequisite, 'interactive', into a condition under which that word can keep holding as the graph grows; the gate therefore checks that the conversion is licensed by the prerequisite's own words, that it adds a condition instead of restating them, that it keeps the two halves that make it a change-proportional condition rather than a budget, a capacity claim or a mechanism, and that the recorded statement is decidable without a rule the prerequisite does not state. It reviews the dependent's wording, not any implementation, and records no outcome.
